title: Reformer: Deep learning model for characterizing protein-RNA interactions from sequence at single-base resolution
one_liner_zh: 该文用深度学习模型Reformer从序列预测蛋白-RNA结合亲和力，对象是RNA结合蛋白与RNA互作而非无序蛋白/IDR介导的PPI，且无相分离或物理模拟机制建模，仅部分方法可迁移。
abstract: Protein-RNA interactions play an essential role in the regulation of transcription, translation, and metabolism of cellular RNA. Here, we develop Reformer, a deep learning model that predicts protein-RNA binding affinity purely from sequence. We developed Reformer with 155 RNA binding protein (RBP) targets from 3 cell lines. Reformer achieved high prediction accuracy at single-base resolution when tasking with inferring protein- and cell-type-specific binding affinity. We conducted electrophoretic mobility shift assays to validate high-impact RNA regulation mutations predicted by Reformer. In addition, Reformer learned to capture protein binding motifs that cannot be discovered by eCLIP-seq experiments. Furthermore, we demonstrated that motif signatures related to RNA processing functions are encoded within Reformer. In conclusion, Reformer will facilitate interpretation of the regulation mechanisms underlying RNA processing.
abstract_zh: 蛋白质-RNA相互作用在细胞RNA的转录、翻译及代谢调控中扮演着至关重要的角色。在此，我们开发了Reformer，一种仅从序列出发预测蛋白质-RNA结合亲和力的深度学习模型。我们利用来自3个细胞系的155个RNA结合蛋白（RBP）靶标构建了Reformer。在推断蛋白质及细胞类型特异性结合亲和力的任务中，Reformer在单碱基分辨率下实现了高预测精度。我们通过电泳迁移率变动实验验证了Reformer预测的高影响RNA调控突变。此外，Reformer还学会了捕捉eCLIP-seq实验无法发现的蛋白质结合基序。进一步地，我们证明了与RNA加工功能相关的基序特征编码于Reformer内部。总之，Reformer将有助于解析RNA加工背后的调控机制。
